title: Damage and inspection findings
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on whether inspections found damage and on one case where collision repairs prevented further work.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say inspections found no vehicle damage.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe a vehicle stuck in the shop for collision damage repairs, which blocked diagnosis of another problem.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined review mentions a car inspection being messed up but gives too little detail to identify the specific issue or outcome.

limitations: The sample is very small, so examples are insufficient to characterize broader patterns.
One fragment is too vague to determine whether the issue concerns inspection quality, damage, or another problem.
